events.title: ChatGPT Launch Marks AI Mainstream Era
events.description: OpenAI launches ChatGPT, reaching 1 million users in just 5 days, marking the beginning of widespread AI adoption
events.content: OpenAI released ChatGPT to the public, a conversational AI that demonstrated unprecedented capabilities in natural language understanding. The platform broke records by becoming the fastest-growing application, attracting massive mainstream attention.

events.title: Google Releases Bard AI Assistant
events.description: Google announces its AI assistant 'Bard' to compete with ChatGPT, bringing AI conversation to billions
events.content: Google announced Bard, its AI conversational assistant, as a response to ChatGPT's success. The announcement signaled the beginning of a major AI arms race among tech giants.

events.title: AI Regulation Discussions Begin
events.description: Governments worldwide begin discussing frameworks for AI regulation and safety measures
events.content: Following rapid AI adoption, world leaders convened to discuss regulatory frameworks for artificial intelligence. The UK government published AI regulatory principles focusing on transparency and accountability.

events.title: GPT-4 Released - Advanced Capabilities
events.description: OpenAI launches GPT-4 with significantly improved reasoning and multimodal capabilities
events.content: GPT-4 introduced new capabilities including the ability to process both text and images, showing improved reasoning across complex domains and better accuracy in specialized areas.

events.title: AI Integration in Enterprise Software
events.description: Major companies integrate AI into their products - Microsoft adds Copilot to Office suite
events.content: Microsoft announced deep integration of AI capabilities throughout its Office suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, demonstrating enterprise-wide AI adoption.

events.title: AI Safety Standards Proposed
events.description: International bodies propose standards for responsible AI development and deployment
events.content: International Standard Organization provides guidelines for AI safety, security, and transparency. Companies begin implementing standards for responsible AI use across all sectors.

events.title: Anthropic Reaches $5B Valuation
events.description: AI safety-focused startup Anthropic reaches $5 billion valuation, backed by Google and others
events.content: Anthropic, founded by former OpenAI researchers, secured significant funding to develop safer AI systems, reaching a $5 billion valuation and demonstrating investor confidence in responsible AI.

events.title: Multimodal AI Platforms Dominate
events.description: AI systems capable of understanding and generating text, images, and video become mainstream
events.content: New generation of AI models that process and generate multiple types of content simultaneously become industry standard, enabling new creative and productive applications.

events.title: Paris Climate Agreement Achieved
events.description: Nearly 200 countries sign the Paris Agreement to combat global warming
events.content: The Paris Agreement was adopted at COP21, representing the first legally binding global climate agreement with targets to limit warming to well below 2°C.

events.title: Glasgow Climate Pact (COP26) Agreed
events.description: COP26 concludes with agreement to accelerate climate action through 2030
events.content: COP26 in Glasgow resulted in commitments to strengthen climate targets for 2030 and established carbon market rules for international emissions trading.

events.title: Global Renewable Energy Capacity Exceeds 3 TW
events.description: Renewable energy sources reach record capacity milestone, marking shift in global energy
events.content: The International Energy Agency reported that renewable energy capacity surpassed 3 terawatts globally, with solar and wind leading the expansion.

events.title: Dubai Climate Conference Sets New Targets
events.description: COP28 in Dubai establishes unprecedented agreement to transition away from fossil fuels
events.content: For the first time in climate negotiations, countries agreed to 'transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems' as part of COP28's final agreement.

events.title: Electric Vehicle Sales Reach 14 Million
events.description: Global EV sales milestone achieved, accounting for 18% of total car sales
events.content: Electric vehicle sales surpassed 14 million units globally in 2024, representing a significant shift in transportation and contributing to emissions reduction goals.

events.title: Carbon Pricing Mechanisms Expand
events.description: More countries implement carbon pricing and emission trading systems
events.content: Carbon pricing mechanisms covering about 25% of global emissions are now in place, with more countries launching market-based climate solutions.

events.title: Unicorn Era Begins
events.description: First technology startup reaches $1 billion valuation without IPO - 'Unicorn' term coined
events.content: Airbulb became the first startup to reach a $1 billion valuation while still private, marking the beginning of the unicorn era in venture capital.

events.title: Decacorn Club Established
events.description: First startups reach $10 billion valuation milestone
events.content: Companies like Uber and Airbnb became decacorns, reaching $10+ billion valuations and demonstrating the massive scale potential of technology startups.

events.title: Creator Economy Boom
events.description: Startups enabling content creators surge, including Patreon, Discord, and others
events.content: Platforms built for creators achieved rapid growth and significant valuations, creating a new category of business and supporting billions in creator earnings.

events.title: AI Startup Funding Explosion
events.description: Venture capital flooding into AI startups following ChatGPT success
events.content: Following ChatGPT's viral success, venture capital investment in AI startups increased dramatically, with numerous companies raising massive Series A and B rounds.

events.title: B2B SaaS Maturation Phase
events.description: B2B software companies transition to profitability and sustainable growth models
events.content: Mature SaaS companies demonstrated path to profitability with efficient unit economics, shifting investor focus from growth at all costs to sustainable business models.

events.title: Climate Tech Startups Rise
events.description: Significant investment in startups addressing climate change and sustainability
events.content: Climate technology startups attracted increased venture funding for solutions in carbon capture, renewable energy, and sustainable agriculture.

events.title: First Space Station Module Launched
events.description: Mir space station module marks human's first permanent residence in space
events.content: Soviet Union launched the first module of Mir space station, beginning a new era of long-term human presence in space.

events.title: International Space Station Completed
events.description: ISS construction completed after 12 years, becoming humanity's laboratory in orbit
events.content: The International Space Station, a collaborative effort of multiple nations, was substantially complete and began its 20-year operational phase.

events.title: SpaceX Lands Reusable Rocket
events.description: SpaceX achieves first successful landing of orbital-class rocket booster
events.content: SpaceX successfully landed Falcon 9's first stage booster, proving reusable rocket technology and dramatically reducing space launch costs.

events.title: Humans Return to the Moon
events.description: NASA's Artemis program successfully lands astronauts on lunar surface
events.content: After a 52-year gap, humans returned to the Moon with the Artemis I mission, establishing a foothold for future lunar exploration and Mars missions.

events.title: First Private Space Station Launched
events.description: Private companies deploy their own space station modules for commercial use
events.content: Axiom Space launched modules for the first privately-developed space station, marking the beginning of commercial spaceflight infrastructure.

events.title: Mars Sample Return Mission Success
events.description: Samples from Mars successfully returned to Earth for analysis
events.content: NASA's Mars Sample Return mission successfully brought back rock samples from the Martian surface, enabling detailed analysis of potential past microbial life.

events.title: First Quantum Computer Prototype
events.description: IBM demonstrates first practical quantum computer with multiple qubits
events.content: IBM made its quantum computers available through the cloud, allowing researchers to experiment with quantum computing and accelerating development.

events.title: Google Announces Quantum Supremacy
events.description: Google claims their quantum computer performs task impossible for classical computers
events.content: Google announced 'quantum supremacy,' demonstrating their quantum processor completed a complex calculation exponentially faster than the world's fastest supercomputers.

events.title: Atom Computing Develops 1000+ Qubit System
events.description: Atom Computing reaches breakthrough with over 1000 neutral atom qubits
events.content: Atom Computing announced a quantum system with over 1000 qubits using neutral atoms, a significant step toward practical quantum computers.

events.title: Quantum Computing Applications Emerging
events.description: First real-world applications in drug discovery and materials science demonstrated
events.content: Researchers demonstrate quantum computers solving meaningful problems in pharmaceutical research and material design, moving beyond theoretical demonstrations.

events.title: Quantum Error Correction Major Milestone
events.description: Google demonstrates quantum error correction breakthrough
events.content: Google achieved a major breakthrough in quantum error correction, showing that more qubits could actually improve stability when properly configured.

events.title: Kyoto Protocol Established
events.description: International agreement to reduce greenhouse gas emissions through renewable energy
events.content: The Kyoto Protocol was adopted, creating the first legally binding climate agreement and promoting renewable energy adoption worldwide.

events.title: Solar Energy Becomes Cost-Competitive
events.description: Solar power costs drop below fossil fuel costs in many regions
events.content: IRENA reported that solar and wind power had become the cheapest sources of electricity in most markets, accelerating renewable energy adoption.

events.title: Denmark Reaches 80% Wind Power
events.description: Denmark becomes global leader in wind energy generation
events.content: Denmark announced that wind power generated 80% of its electricity for the year, demonstrating the viability of renewable energy at national scale.

events.title: Global Renewable Capacity Reaches 3.7 TW
events.description: Renewable energy capacity surpasses fossil fuel capacity for first time
events.content: International Energy Agency reported that renewable energy capacity exceeded fossil fuel capacity for the first time, a historic milestone in energy transition.

events.title: Battery Storage Becomes Key Infrastructure
events.description: Energy storage technology enables 100% renewable power grids
events.content: Advances in battery storage technology made it economically viable to support electricity grids powered entirely by renewable sources.

events.title: Green Hydrogen Production Scales
events.description: Green hydrogen produced from renewable electricity becomes commercially viable
events.content: Countries worldwide launched green hydrogen production facilities, enabling decarbonization of heavy industry and long-distance transportation.
